title: TelcoAgent: A Scalable 5G Multi-KPM Forecasting With 3GPP-Grounded Explainability
abstract: arXiv:2606.19821v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Key Performance Measurement (KPM) forecasting is essential for proactive network management of 5G and next-generation telecom networks. However, existing machine learning (ML) approaches face significant limitations in scalability and explainability, restricting their effectiveness in real-world deployments. translated_title: TelcoAgent：具有基于3GPP可解释性的可扩展5G多KPM预测
translated_abstract: 关键性能测量（KPM）预测对于5G及下一代电信网络的主动式网络管理至关重要。然而，现有的机器学习方法在可扩展性和可解释性方面存在显著局限，限制了其在实际部署中的有效性。我们提出了TelcoAgent，这是一个基于基础模型的框架，无需针对特定站点进行训练，即可对跨多个网络小区的多个KPM实现准确、可扩展且可解释的预测。具体而言，该框架包含三个关键组件：(i) 一个自动化三智能体流水线，可直接从3GPP规范文档构建第三代合作伙伴计划（3GPP）知识图谱；(ii) 一个基于时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的可扩展预测流水线，可提供准确的零样本预测；(iii) 一个推理与解释流水线，可提供可操作的、基于领域知识的解释。
tldr: 提出TelcoAgent框架，通过自动构建3GPP知识图谱、零样本时间序列基础模型预测和领域可解释推理三个组件，实现了无需站点特定训练的准确、可扩展且可解释的5G多KPM预测。
en_tdlr: TelcoAgent is a foundation model-based framework that enables accurate, scalable, and explainable forecasting of multiple 5G KPMs across network cells without site-specific training, combining automated 3GPP knowledge graph construction, zero-shot time-series prediction, and domain-grounded explainability.
